mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 4, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note: ice_block07: a rock buried in deep snow, dark stone showing only at the creases - read as snow, which is most of it.
why_this_one: 52 of them: the snow-buried boulders along the fields.
effects_note: No arm in MuMain's WD_2DEVIAS switches: static.
